Purevara: An eCommerce Project by Xylo Solutions

Wellness essentials brand redesigned to improve conversions, elevate trust, and create a premium Shopify customer journey.

Project showcase

Purevara is a modern wellness brand offering shower steamers and self care essentials designed to bring calm, clarity, and recovery into everyday routines. Xylo Solutions partnered with the brand to redesign the storefront into a more premium, emotionally engaging, and high converting ecommerce experience. As a trusted shopify website design company, we rebuilt the store to better communicate lifestyle benefits, product quality, and repeat purchase value.

The project included a complete homepage redesign, product page CRO enhancements, and cleaner brand storytelling throughout the customer journey. Key sections were structured to highlight benefits such as aromatherapy support, relaxation rituals, gifting appeal, and daily wellness use cases. As an experienced shopify web design company, we improved mobile responsiveness, simplified navigation, and optimized collection browsing for faster product discovery across every device.

To increase sales, we introduced trust focused layouts, stronger call to actions, cleaner hierarchy, and persuasive conversion elements across the funnel. Product pages were optimized to reduce hesitation and help shoppers quickly understand scents, routines, and bundle opportunities. This project reflects the standards of a modern shopify website design agency delivering premium shopify web design services, shopify website design services, and growth focused shopify design services for ambitious ecommerce brands. The final result was a polished storefront built for higher retention, stronger average order value, and scalable long term growth.
